meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用容器内已安装的 anydoc 命令行工具，把消息中给出的本地附件（Word、演示文稿、表格、文本型 PDF 等）转成 Markdown 文件并输出路径；转换全程在本地容器内完成，不经外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当消息提供本地附件路径、需要读取该文件又不把它上传到外部解析器时触发；本地转换是默认做法。

say.text: 这个 PDF 我给了本地路径，转成 Markdown 再读关键部分
从 stdin 读这个 CSV，格式指定为 csv
say.note: 用 --format csv 显式声明格式

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the preinstalled anydoc CLI to convert the local attachment path given in your message (Word, slides, spreadsheets, text-based PDF, etc.) into a Markdown file inside the agent container, without uploading it to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser; local conversion is the default.

say_en.text: This PDF has a local path — convert it to Markdown, then read the relevant parts
say_en.note: Large files: only relevant sections are read

say_en.text: Read this CSV from stdin, with the format set to csv
say_en.note: Declares the format explicitly via --format csv
